plainSummary: Valid screenshot coverage can still be reported as missing when a surface has multiple saved captures.
summary: Bounded hunt ran pnpm --filter @nessalabs/spec-ledger build && node --test packages/ledger/dist/evidence/visual.break.test.js; 4 pass, 1 fails. Greedy digest consumption rejects Desktop[A,B], Mobile[A] despite valid assignment Desktop=B, Mobile=A.

findings.gap: checkVisualEvidence assigns the first eligible digest to each surface without reassigning earlier choices, so a full unique matching can be rejected.
findings.plainImpact: An agent can be prevented from finishing even after it supplies valid distinct screenshots for every required surface.
findings.fixProposal: Find a matching between required surfaces and valid image digests; allow alternate captures to free a digest needed by a later surface.

evidence.citedTest: packages/ledger/src/evidence/visual.break.test.ts::visual breaker: alternative screenshots satisfy distinct surfaces regardless of attachment order
evidence.observedOutput: AssertionError: Desktop can use B while Mobile uses A; unique valid coverage exists. false !== true

residualRisks: One out-of-intent killer: alternate image allocation across surfaces. Final screenshot visual review still pending.
